items.title: The 4:59 PM Email
items.premise: An Employee gets ready to leave at 4:59 PM when the Clueless Boss sends an urgent request for a 50-slide deck. The Employee hands over a pre-made generic slide deck generated by AI that just repeats the word 'Synergy', making the Boss cry tears of joy and send everyone home.

items.title: Mute Button Mishap
items.premise: A Lazy Coworker forgets to mute their mic during a big team call while loudly eating chips and complaining about the Boss. When caught, they quickly claim it was a dedicated ASMR team-building exercise that the Boss accidentally loved.

items.title: The Temperature War
items.premise: Dad guards the home thermostat like a sacred treasure during a scorching summer day. The Teen sneaks an ice pack over the sensor, tricking the thermostat into thinking it is freezing and forcing Dad to turn on the AC himself.

items.title: Grandma's WiFi Secret
items.premise: Mom spends two frustrating hours using simple analogies to explain how to connect to the WiFi to Grandma. As soon as Mom steps away, Grandma secretly fixes the router's DNS settings herself, revealing she just wanted someone to talk to.

items.title: The Bill Splitter
items.premise: A guy takes his date out and pulls out a spreadsheet to split the bill down to the exact percentage of water drank. The Date gets Bestfriend advice over text and uses 'spreadsheet logic' to invoice him a fee for listening to his terrible jokes.

items.title: Ghosting Returns
items.premise: A girl gets ghosted for three weeks until her ex suddenly texts 'Hey stranger' late at night. She sends back a automated-style out-of-office reply stating her emotional support center is permanently closed due to insufficient effort.

items.title: Group Project Division
items.premise: Teacher assigns a group project, and Student A ends up doing all the research, writing, and design alone. On presentation day, Student A lists the Slacker Student's contribution on the title slide as 'Moral Support and Snacks', getting an instant laugh and A+ from the teacher.

items.title: The Pen Theft Ring
items.premise: A Student loses their favorite black gel pen and launches a dramatic noir detective investigation inside the classroom. The twist reveals the Teacher took it to grade the pop quiz that the Student completely forgot to study for.

items.title: Coffee Math
items.premise: A Broke Guy calculates that skipping his $5 daily cafe coffee will make him a millionaire in 30 years. He immediately spends $200 on fancy home barista gear that makes terrible espresso, learning that impulse buying defeats micro-budgeting.

items.title: The Free Trial Trap
items.premise: A Broke Guy signs up for ten free trials using burner emails to watch a single movie, but forgets to cancel them. A month later, his bank balance hits negative numbers, leading to a hilarious budget breakdown with a friendly banker who teaches him how to set calendar reminders.

items.title: The Secret Pay-It-Forward
items.premise: A Teen secretly uses their saved allowance to pay for a stressed stranger's coffee at a cafe. The stranger turns out to be their overwhelmed Teacher, who is so moved by the random act of kindness that she cancels the surprise test planned for that morning.

items.title: The Lost Wallet Test
items.premise: A Young Man finds a wallet loaded with cash on the street and tracks down the elderly owner to return it intact. The Grandma rewards him with a home-cooked meal and an old budgeting tip that saves him from falling for an online scam later that week.
